name: Semantic Equivalence Constraint
description: Reformulates the graph connectivity problem as an equivalence relation problem over abstract variables, where activating a constraint enforces equality. The required terminals become variables that must be forced to take the same value. The tree structure guarantees unique paths of equivalence. This obfuscates the spatial "routing" and "spanning tree" keywords, forcing models to infer that transitive equality over unique constraint paths is mathematically identical to finding a minimal subtree.
